description: Deletes the app file the owner uploaded and the plan built from it. Use it when the owner asks to delete their uploaded file. what=all also clears the queued changes. Safe to repeat. It does not touch tokens or billing.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

what.description: export (default): the uploaded file and the plan. all: also the queued changes.

name: nc_forget
title: Delete the uploaded app file (free)
